about: Questions for scripts/routing-eval.ts (#487). Every page, name and block named here is made up and lives in tests/fixtures/graph/ (see tests/fixtures/README.md). expected_type is the tool type a good first call has: get (the caller names the one thing), find (the caller has criteria and wants a list), explore (the caller has a starting point and wants what surrounds it), check (the caller is about to write). v1_tools and v2_tools are the tools that count as the right first call on each surface; the script maps a tool to its type itself, so a tool outside the list can still be type-correct.
